findings.note: Token-store tmp file is a predictable sibling (store.tmp) opened WITHOUT O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW: a local attacker with dir write can pre-place a symlink and get an arbitrary file truncated (O_TRUNC follows). Use O_EXCL (or mktemp) for the tmp.

INFOs: (a) unauthenticated DCR capped at 200 clients — cap-fill is a minor registration DoS, acceptable for owner-hosted; (b) refresh accepts missing client_id (standard public-client practice); (c) PARTIAL scope: server/tools/state/docs/tests unreviewed; #275-original state/tools still open (differ from #279).
